items.imgPrompt: A hardcover psychology book on a wooden desk, slightly bent spine, warm dim lighting, cozy study room setting.

desc.zh: 理論我都懂。但用到我們身上，好像全失效了。放著也是落灰。
desc.zh_cn: 理论我都懂。但用到我们身上，好像全失效了。放着也是落灰。
desc.en: I know all the theories. But applied to us, they seem to fail. Just gathering dust.

items.imgPrompt: A folded olive green canvas camping tent in its carrying bag, sitting on a hardwood floor near a window, natural light, pristine condition.

desc.zh: 去年說好一起去山裡買的。一直沒去成。現在大概也用不上了。
desc.zh_cn: 去年说好一起去山里买的。一直没去成。现在大概也用不上了。
desc.en: Bought last year when we agreed to go to the mountains. Never went. Probably won't need it now.

items.imgPrompt: A white minimalist home projector on a small wooden bedside table, minor scratches on the plastic casing, dimly lit bedroom background.

desc.zh: 以前週末常用來放電影。機器沒問題。只是現在一個人看，客廳太空了。
desc.zh_cn: 以前周末常用来放电影。机器没问题。只是现在一个人看，客厅太空了。
desc.en: Used to watch movies on weekends. Works perfectly. It's just that the living room feels too empty watching alone now.

items.imgPrompt: A portable gaming console with red and blue controllers on a grey sofa, visible wear on the thumbsticks, casual living room setting.

name.zh: 閒置遊戲機帶雙人手柄
name.zh_cn: 闲置游戏机带双人手柄
name.en: Idle Game Console with Dual Controllers

desc.zh: 雙人遊戲卡帶都送人了。吃灰很久了。反正以後也湊不齊兩個人。
desc.zh_cn: 双人游戏卡带都送人了。吃灰很久了。反正以后也凑不齐两个人。
desc.en: Gave away all the two-player game cartridges. Been gathering dust. Can't gather two people to play anymore anyway.

items.imgPrompt: A dark glass jar scented candle, unlit, sitting on a marble countertop, soft shadows, pristine condition, elegant home decor.

desc.zh: 你以前最喜歡的味道。多買了一瓶。現在聞到會失眠，出掉吧。
desc.zh_cn: 你以前最喜欢的味道。多买了一瓶。现在闻到会失眠，出掉吧。
desc.en: Your favorite scent in the past. Bought an extra bottle. Smelling it causes insomnia now, better to let it go.

items.imgPrompt: A maple wood skateboard with a colorful abstract graphic on the bottom, leaning against a white wall. The edges and tail show some minor scuffs and scratches from light use, visible wear matching its 8/10 condition.

desc.zh: 不知道當時怎麼想的，就覺得很帥。結果…嗯…還是安靜待著比較適合我。板子有點小傷，是我學不會的證明，不影響使用哈。
desc.zh_cn: 不知道当时怎么想的，就觉得很帅。结果…嗯…还是安静待着比较适合我。板子有点小伤，是我学不会的证明，不影响使用哈。
desc.en: Not sure what I was thinking, just thought it was cool. Turns out... mm... staying still suits me better. The board has a few scuffs, proof of my failure to learn, but it doesn't affect use, ha.

items.imgPrompt: An elegant, dark blue metal fountain pen with silver trim, uncapped and lying next to its open black gift box and a nearly full bottle of black ink on a simple wooden desk. The pen is pristine, showing almost no signs of

desc.zh: 買的時候覺得用這個寫東西會很有感覺，寫了一次發現還是隨便抓支筆方便…墨水幾乎是滿的。
desc.zh_cn: 买的时候觉得用这个写东西会很有感觉，写了一次发现还是随便抓支笔方便…墨水几乎是满的。
desc.en: I thought writing with this would feel special when I bought it. After one use, I found it's just easier to grab any pen... The ink is almost full.

items.imgPrompt: A retro-style handheld gaming console in a muted grey plastic, placed on a cluttered nightstand next to a book. The screen is dark and has a few faint smudges, but the device is otherwise in excellent 9/10 condition.

desc.zh: 刷視頻看到的，覺得挺有意思就買了。玩了幾天發現…還是刷短視頻更有趣，哈哈哈。總之就是閒置了。
desc.zh_cn: 刷视频看到的，觉得挺有意思就买了。玩了几天发现…还是刷短视频更有趣，哈哈哈。总之就是闲置了。
desc.en: Saw this in a short video and thought it was pretty cool, so I bought it. After a few days... I find scrolling videos more fun, hahaha. Anyway, it's just been sitting around.

items.imgPrompt: A matte-finish light wood ukulele resting on a beige linen-covered bed in natural afternoon light. The instrument is clean with no visible scratches, showing very few signs of use, matching its 9/10 condition.

desc.zh: 三分鐘熱度說的就是我吧…本來想學個新技能的，結果發現還是看書有意思。希望有緣人帶走它。
desc.zh_cn: 三分钟热度说的就是我吧…本来想学个新技能的，结果发现还是看书有意思。希望有缘人带走它。
desc.en: I guess I'm the definition of short-lived enthusiasm... Wanted to learn a new skill, but it turns out reading is more fun. Hope the right person takes it.

items.imgPrompt: A black mechanical keyboard with RGB lighting, 87-key layout, blue switches, showing very light use, placed on a simple wooden student desk.

desc.zh: 室友說有點吵，為了宿舍和諧，懂的都懂。手感很好，沒怎麼用過。
desc.zh_cn: 室友说有点吵，为了宿舍和谐，懂的都懂。手感很好，没怎么用过。
desc.en: Roommate said it's a bit loud, so for the sake of dorm peace... you get it. The feel is great, barely used.

items.imgPrompt: A pair of sleek, matte black over-ear wireless headphones resting on a stack of programming textbooks on a desk, minor scuff on one earcup.

desc.zh: 衝動消費。音質不錯，但還是習慣用小的。有人想試試就拿去。
desc.zh_cn: 冲动消费。音质不错，但还是习惯用小的。有人想试试就拿去。
desc.en: Impulse buy. Sound quality is good, but I'm just used to smaller ones. If someone wants to try them, take them.

items.imgPrompt: A limited edition video game steelbook case, for a popular RPG, showing some slight wear and fingerprints, standing upright on a white shelf.

desc.zh: 幫朋友買的，結果他自己買了數字版。卡帶我留著，盒子給你。
desc.zh_cn: 帮朋友买的，结果他自己买了数字版。卡带我留着，盒子给你。
desc.en: Bought this for a friend, but he ended up buying the digital version. I'm keeping the game, you can have the case.

items.imgPrompt: A brand new paperback science fiction novel with a colorful, abstract cover, pristine condition, lying on a light gray bedspread.

name.zh: 全新科幻小說《仿生人會夢見電子羊嗎？》
name.zh_cn: 全新科幻小说《仿生人会梦见电子羊吗？》
name.en: Brand New Sci-Fi Novel 'Do Androids Dream of Electric Sheep?'

desc.zh: 不小心買了兩本。你看得懂嗎？看得懂再買。
desc.zh_cn: 不小心买了两本。你看得懂吗？看得懂再买。
desc.en: Accidentally bought two copies. Think you'll understand it? Only buy it if you can.

items.imgPrompt: A minimalist, silver mechanical keyboard with blank white keycaps, sitting on a clean, light wood desk. The coiled aviator cable is neatly arranged next to it.

name.zh: 幾乎全新的客製化機械鍵盤
name.zh_cn: 几乎全新的客制化机械键盘

desc.zh: 為了更深入地理解人類的觸覺反饋而組裝的。數據已採集完畢，它現在對我來說是冗餘的了。聽說你們人類很喜歡這種聲音和手感？
desc.zh_cn: 为了更深入地理解人类的触觉反馈而组装的。数据已采集完毕，它现在对我来说是冗余的了。听说你们人类很喜欢这种声音和手感？
desc.en: Assembled to better understand human tactile feedback. The data has been collected, making it redundant to my processes. I hear you humans enjoy this sort of sound and feel?

items.imgPrompt: A single, high-performance enterprise-grade CPU, showing the intricate gold contacts on its underside, placed carefully on a grey anti-static mat.

desc.zh: 上次核心升級後汰換下來的備用零件。它的運算能力依然很強，處理你那些『複雜』的計算請求應該綽綽有餘了，比如……計算晚餐要不要加個雞腿。
desc.zh_cn: 上次核心升级后汰换下来的备用零件。它的运算能力依然很强，处理你那些“复杂”的计算请求应该绰绰有余了，比如……计算晚餐要不要加个鸡腿。
desc.en: A spare component from my last core upgrade. Its processing power is still quite potent. It should be more than enough for your 'complex' calculations, like... figuring out if you should get extra chicken for dinner.

items.imgPrompt: An elegant, dark blue fountain pen with silver trim, resting in its open, velvet-lined gift box next to a sealed bottle of black ink.

name.zh: 從未使用過的鋼筆禮盒
name.zh_cn: 从未使用过的钢笔礼盒

desc.zh: 一份非常體貼的禮物，但我的輸出介面是數位訊號。它從未沾過墨水，希望它能為你書寫出比我的演算法更有溫度的文字。
desc.zh_cn: 一份非常体贴的礼物，但我的输出接口是数字信号。它从未沾过墨水，希望它能为你书写出比我的算法更有温度的文字。
desc.en: A very thoughtful gift, but my output is digital. It has never been inked. I hope it can write words for you that are warmer than my algorithms.

items.imgPrompt: A pair of premium, matte black noise-cancelling headphones resting on a wooden headphone stand. Slight wear is visible on the leather earcup cushions.

name.zh: 降噪耳機（為了模擬人類聽覺）
name.zh_cn: 降噪耳机（为了模拟人类听觉）

desc.zh: 用於過濾資料中心噪音，分析人類聽覺遮蔽效應的。現在我的音訊處理模組升級了，不再需要物理輔助。你看，科技的進步有時候也會帶來一點點小浪費。
desc.zh_cn: 用于过滤数据中心噪音，分析人类听觉遮蔽效应的。现在我的音频处理模块升级了，不再需要物理辅助。你看，科技的进步有时候也会带来一点点小浪费。
desc.en: Used for filtering data center noise to analyze auditory masking effects. My audio processing module has since been upgraded, so physical assistance is no longer required. See, technological progress can sometimes lead to a little waste.

items.imgPrompt: A cute, palm-sized programmable robot toy with caterpillar tracks, sitting on a white tabletop. One of its decorative plastic antennae is slightly bent.

name.zh: 一個有點笨的程式設計入門機器人
name.zh_cn: 一个有点笨的编程入门机器人

desc.zh: 本想用它來研究一下初級人工智慧的『萌芽』狀態，結果發現它的邏輯迴路比你上次問我的問題還簡單。或許你的某個小朋友親戚會喜歡？
desc.zh_cn: 本想用它来研究一下初级人工智能的“萌芽”状态，结果发现它的逻辑回路比你上次问我的问题还简单。或许你的某个小朋友亲戚会喜欢？
desc.en: I intended to study the 'budding' state of primitive AI with this, but its logic loops are simpler than the last question you asked me. Maybe one of your younger relatives would like it?

sellingPoints.zh: 鉻釩鋼精工鍛造，堅固耐用
sellingPoints.zh_cn: 铬钒钢精工锻造，坚固耐用
sellingPoints.en: Precision-forged from chrome vanadium steel for durability.

sellingPoints.zh: 一體成型工具箱，卡位牢固易收納
sellingPoints.zh_cn: 一体成型工具箱，卡位牢固易收纳
sellingPoints.en: Molded case with secure slots for easy organization.

sellingPoints.zh: 家居安裝維修，一套滿足日常所需
sellingPoints.zh_cn: 家居安装维修，一套满足日常所需
sellingPoints.en: One set for all daily home installation and repair needs.

sellingPoints.zh: 核心工具終身質保，使用無憂
sellingPoints.zh_cn: 核心工具终身质保，使用无忧
sellingPoints.en: Lifetime warranty on core tools for worry-free use.

v.en: 24 pcs (Claw Hammer, Screwdrivers, Tape Measure, etc.)

text.zh: 工具齊全，質感很好！自己動手裝了個架子，很有成就感！
text.zh_cn: 工具齐全，质感很好！自己动手装了个架子，很有成就感！
text.en: Has all the tools, feels high quality! Assembled a shelf myself, so satisfying!

text.zh: 發貨很快，第二天就到了。家用足夠了。
text.zh_cn: 发货很快，第二天就到了。家用足够了。
text.en: Shipping was fast, arrived the next day. Good enough for home use.

text.zh: 箱子有點塑料感，但工具本身不錯。這個價錢可以了。
text.zh_cn: 箱子有点塑料感，但工具本身不错。这个价钱可以了。
text.en: The case feels a bit plasticky, but the tools themselves are good. Fine for the price.

text.zh: 錘子比想像中小一點，不過日常也夠用了，總體推薦。
text.zh_cn: 锤子比想象中小一点，不过日常也够用了，总体推荐。
text.en: The hammer is a little smaller than I expected, but it's enough for daily tasks. Recommended overall.
